info.title: Orders
info.x-hubspot-api-use-case: When a buyer adds a set of products to their cart and makes a purchase, store it as an individual order. You can then update the order with tracking information once the shipping label has been printed.
info.x-hubspot-introduction: Use the orders API to create and manage data related to ecommerce purchases in HubSpot. This can be especially useful for keeping HubSpot data synced with external ecommerce platforms, such as Shopify and NetSuite.

post.description: Returns a batch of orders matching the provided internal IDs or unique property values, with partial success indicated by a 207 response.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{orderId}`. `{orderId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param.  Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the order to retrieve.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived

parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{orderId}` to the recycling bin.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the order to delete.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{orderId}`. `{orderId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the order to update.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

post.summary: Archive a batch of orders by ID
post.description: Archives the specified orders by ID, returning no content on success.
Returns a batch of newly created order objects, including their assigned IDs and properties. Partial success indicated by 207.
Returns the updated order objects after applying the specified property changes to each record in the batch.

parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results

parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored

Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request
